summary_md: **Albarino ([@chl708](https://x.com/chl708/status/2116429025413341217))** flags the new **blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories** setting in Claude Code 2.1.314, which makes Write/Edit/NotebookEdit refuse paths outside working directories in every permission mode; he enables it for unattended and CI agents ([release v2.1.314](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.314)).
relevance: File-write sandboxing for unattended agent runs.
